title: Add Pollin Uptime (HA Gateway) to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Pollin Uptime (HA Gateway)](https://brhost.eu.org) to build
- Zero-downtime serverless AI gateway and multimodal playground with automatic 4-layer fallback cascade. Never hit 500 errors or rate limits again — seamlessly route Chat, Vision, Images, Video, and Voi

Fixes #14411

gist.headline: Four backup hives
gist.blurb: Pollin Uptime has joined the build: a multimodal gateway that keeps a few extra paths through the garden. Chat, vision, images, video, and voice can take the scenic route when a provider gets grumpy.
gist.summary: Added Pollin Uptime (HA Gateway) to the app build, providing a serverless multimodal playground with an automatic four-layer fallback cascade for Chat, Vision, Images, Video, and Voice requests.
gist.impact: People can discover and use Pollin Uptime through the build for more resilient multimodal AI routing, with fallback paths designed to keep requests moving.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny gateway keeper tending four branching garden paths from a cozy retro terminal, each leading to a different multimodal icon: chat bubble, eye, picture frame, video reel, and speaker. A cheerful CRT Monitor Robot can point at the four healthy routes while small flowers and code-plants grow around the gateway, representing automatic fallback and uptime.

Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, code-plants and flowers throughout, with small pixel-font text: '4-LAYER FALLBACK' in dark purple (#110518).
